subject.title: Reject unsupported diagnostics OTel grpc config

question: Should this PR's doctor migration be accepted as the upgrade path for shipped `diagnostics.otel.protocol: "grpc"` configs?
rationale: The PR intentionally removes a shipped config value and changes upgrade behavior for existing configs, which is compatibility-sensitive even though it preserves the previous effective no-export runtime result.

options.title: Accept the doctor migration
options.body: Merge the stricter config contract with the legacy repair path after maintainers confirm that disabling active legacy OTLP configs is the intended upgrade behavior.

options.title: Keep grpc as a contract
options.body: Pause or close this PR and sponsor the larger real gRPC exporter implementation instead of removing the advertised config value.

recommendation.title: Accept the doctor migration
recommendation.body: Merge the stricter config contract with the legacy repair path after maintainers confirm that disabling active legacy OTLP configs is the intended upgrade behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The original diagnostics exporter/config surface traces to steipete, making him the best available owner for accepting or redirecting the compatibility direction.
